en:
Invest capital in the town.
Choose what to invest in,
then set the amount.

Toggle between this month's investment
total and the all-time total invested.

Invest locally to boost the town's
economy. This should raise its
economic strength.

Invest locally to build homes and
attract residents. Supporters and
attendances should rise.

Invest locally to boost the town's
enthusiasm for sport. Locals' athletic
ability should rise too.

Invest locally to improve the town's
transport. More people should be
drawn into the town.

#sname#, you can check your total
investment so far.

Set the amount. Left/Right selects
the digit; Up/Down changes the
number.

Invest @Y/%m@ locally to
boost the town's economy.
Is that okay?

Invest @Y/%m@ locally to
attract more residents to the town.
Is that okay?

Invest @Y/%m@ locally to
boost the town's enthusiasm for sport.
Is that okay?

Invest @Y/%m@ locally to
improve the town's transport.
Is that okay?

You don't have the funds to invest.
Please choose again, up to the
amount you have.

On local economy investment, I'd stop
at about @Y/%m@ more
this month.
